intervention: Inspect unchanged original at complete-trajectory and adjacent-row scale, plus wider per-case native focus; follow competing physical components through original windows and inventory complete target features. No new image information is acquired.
success_conditions: For each old competing-fragment alternative record exact original locator, new inspected locator, physically continuous neighbor/target relation with connection-region coordinates, or separately bounded complete neighboring construction plus separation throughout the reviewed relation. A pale gap or proximity alone cannot allocate a detached mark.
Retain and explicitly consider BOTH old alternatives at FC126; both edges at FC108 and FC127, even if one is inconvenient.

New observed target locators are separate sidecars. Before changing eligibility establish which original physical target the old ID refers to; ambiguous reassignment to another component is not a recovery.
Inspect every target bar, branch, closure/opening, long return, terminal and specifically competing mark in wide context. Any unresolved or newly found significant issue keeps full-feature exclusion.
Check same-instance aliases against neighboring annotations, including unresolved references. Envelope intersection alone is neither equality nor distinctness; no invented extra occurrence.
Two independent source readings and final scientific source review must agree on each accepted graphical discharge; agreement without concrete source support is insufficient.
Letter values, cipher/mark functional roles and historical symbol identity stay UNKNOWN. Physical connected-component allocation does not assign historical adjunct ownership or a cipher token.

measurements.window_barrier_before_after: Count all15 fixed cases separately: discharged, partly discharged, retained, or newly blocked. Every discharge needs native coordinate evidence and complete-neighbor/connection observation.
measurements.full_feature_eligibility_before_after: Before0/15 eligible. After only those satisfying all physical-feature, mark-ownership, old-ID target and alias gates; remaining partial cases stay excluded. Overall55+accepted and117-accepted are annotation-profile counts, not glyph/alphabet totals.
measurements.information_not_changed: Source pixels/resolution and135 base unresolved placeholders unchanged; no success measured by generic UNKNOWN field reduction.

forbidden_shortcuts: Dropping significant feature fields or reducing required detail to admit a common body.
Calling A/B consensus, source-window inclusion, pale gap, or a complete pair table visual proof.
Using old class membership, letter keys, corpus, optimizer, other cards258/222 or hypothetical seven assignments.
Treating metadata cause labels as proved physical pixel unavailability.
stop_and_remaining_rule: Return all15 outcomes including failures. For each remaining blocker state whether source-supported local information loss, unidentifiable semantic role, schema convention needing another intervention, recoverable context issue not resolved here, or unassessed. Stop this method when its complete predeclared cohort is exhausted; do not declare all117 irreducible from this bounded experiment.
